title: Certificate: code/ledger.py
signature: forecast(streams, oneoffs, start: date, opening: float, floor: float) -> Ledger ; capacity(ledger, requested_amount) -> Capacity
guarantees: 91 days, day 0 = start. balance[d] = opening + sum of placements with day <= d (credits +, debits -).

Merge rule: recorded occurrences placed first; predicted occurrences at anchor + k*cadence only for days strictly after the stream's last recorded occurrence; assertion fails if a predicted and recorded placement share (stream_id, day).
Anchors before day 0 roll forward by whole cadences.
Amendments: occurrences on/after effective_date use new_amount; ended => no occurrences on/after; one_occurrence_only => only the first occurrence on/after.
One-offs placed at (date - start).days if within 0..90; otherwise ignored.
amount_safe_to_pay = clamp(suffix_min[0] - floor, 0, requested_amount); earliest_full_day = first d with suffix_min[d] - requested_amount >= floor, else null.
Pure: same inputs => identical arrays. Cached on (user_id, start).
